items.title: Quasi-separatedness and separatedness descend along a surjective universally closed morphism of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with its four assertions: for a surjective universally closed morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a base B, quasi-separatedness and separatedness of X (over B, and absolutely) pass to Y (source lines 1777-1788). The proof is a diagram chase on the squares of diagonals Delta_{X/B} and Delta_{Y/B}: the right vertical arrow X x_B X -> Y x_B Y is universally closed as a composite of universally closed morphisms and therefore quasi-compact, which converts quasi-compactness of Delta_{X/B} into quasi-compactness of Delta_{Y/B} by testing on quasi-compact Z over Y x_B Y, and converts the closed immersion property of Delta_{X/B} into universal closedness of Delta_{Y/B}; the last step then uses that the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic spaces is representable, locally of finite type and a monomorphism to upgrade universally closed to a closed immersion.
